title: Intuitive communicators needed for a future event

tellings.quote: and so he told me that there would be some future event where the ability to intuitively communicate would help the military and help you know command and

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant, says that in the early 1990s he worked for the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that listens in on communications, at its headquarters in Maryland. He says that a superior, Captain White, told him there would be some future event where the ability to communicate by intuition, mind to mind, would help the military and its command. In his telling, this is why he was trained for such work, and it would mean the government was preparing for contact with non-human beings.
